THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
168
STUDY 167
Black Leather Jacket & Navy Cami
Rights check
Source: 25060.png
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
stands in an ornately decorated room with floral
wallpaper, gilded lamps, and framed landscape
paintings. She wears a black leather zip jacket with
elasticated cuffs over a fitted navy camisole with a lace
edge. Low-rise washed charcoal jeans complete the
look. Her expression is calm and direct. Warm, soft
interior light. Palette of black, navy, and charcoal, with
warm gold accents. Moody and vintage, in the style of a
classic interior fashion photo.
Moody, vintage, layered
WORKING NOTES
- The leather jacket and lace-edged camisole are the
layering focus.
- Keep the framed paintings and lamp for a lived-in,
vintage room.
